title: GTK4/libadwaita native frontend
description:
Add a native GNOME frontend to SQLator as a fourth frontend, and extract the shared service layer it needs.

SQLator has four frontends' worth of ambition and one frontend's worth of shared code. Roughly 1,000-1,100 of the 1,727 lines in src-tauri/src/commands.rs have a near-verbatim twin in web-server/src/handlers.rs, and the two copies have drifted into five user-visible bugs. tui-app avoided the duplication by depending only on sqlator-core, and consequently cannot use SSH tunnels, Docker connections, or the credential store at all.

A fourth frontend must pick one of those two failure modes unless the service layer is extracted first. So extraction comes first and the GTK app becomes its first consumer.

Five phases: 0a/0b (prerequisites, parallel), 1 (service extraction), 2 (GTK skeleton), 3 (parity), 4 (packaging). Plus a cross-cutting testing/tooling plan that is not a phase.
acceptance_criteria: All child phases closed; sqlator-gtk ships as a Flatpak with feature parity to the Svelte frontend

title: Prevent unintended editor paste when switching query tabs
description: Why this issue exists and what needs to be done: returning to a query tab with SqlEditor can sometimes insert clipboard contents into the editor. Investigate the tab switch and editor remount/focus path, remove the unintended paste behavior, and verify tab switching still preserves expected focus/editing behavior.
